description: Merry Shipmas: The nerdiest Christmas AI hackathon, by NERDCONF. This is the Bengaluru edition : Saturday 12 December 2026, 10:00 to 18:00 IST, in person in Bengaluru (venue to be confirmed). The hackathon opens online on Friday 11 December, and you keep shipping online until Sunday 20 December. The challenge: build something with AI and get real people using it before Christmas. Find your first users in 7 days. Format Fri 11 Dec: kickoff online, from anywhere. Sat 12 Dec: in-person build day in Bengaluru. Meet other builders, mentors and partners. 11 to 20 Dec: 7 days online to ship and find your first users. Judges and prizes are announced soon. Eligibility: open to everyone 18+, students and professionals. Solo or teams of up to 4. Last season: Stranger Builds, our Halloween hackathon, had 1,282 builders sign up and 109 projects shipped. This time, it is Christmas. Hosted by Alex Marin, Co-founder, NERDCONF.

Merry Shipmas: The nerdiest Christmas AI hackathon, by NERDCONF.

This is the Bengaluru edition: Saturday 12 December 2026, 10:00 to 18:00 IST, in person in Bengaluru (venue to be confirmed). The hackathon opens online on Friday 11 December, and you keep shipping online until Sunday 20 December.

The challenge: build something with AI and get real people using it before Christmas. Find your first users in 7 days.

Format

  • Fri 11 Dec: kickoff online, from anywhere.
  • Sat 12 Dec: in-person build day in Bengaluru. Meet other builders, mentors and partners.
  • 11 to 20 Dec: 7 days online to ship and find your first users.
  • Judges and prizes are announced soon.

Eligibility: open to everyone 18+, students and professionals. Solo or teams of up to 4.

Last season: Stranger Builds, our Halloween hackathon, had 1,282 builders sign up and 109 projects shipped. This time, it is Christmas.

Hosted by Alex Marin, Co-founder, NERDCONF.
